# One of Suno's latest investors will be of particular interest to the music industry (Music Business Worldwide)

By Daniel Tencer. Nov 24, 2025.

## Key findings
- Suno raised **$250M Series C** at a **$2.45B** valuation (announced Nov 19); lead investor **Menlo Ventures**.
- **Hallwood Media** is the notable music-industry investor: "the music company founded in 2020 by **Neil Jacobson**, the former President of Universal Music Group's Geffen Records."
- Hallwood's investment arm is **Hallwood Media Ventures (HMV)**; Managing Partners **Todd Lowen and Neil Jacobson**; other members include UMG ex-CFO **Chuck Ciongoli**, ex-EVP **Mike Biggane**, and **Paul Hourican** (ex-TikTok).
- Hallwood "is all in on AI-generated music": signed **Imoliver** (top Suno "music designer") and **Xania Monet** (first AI-powered act to chart on a Billboard airplay chart).
- Xania Monet = AI invention of **Telisha "Nikki" Jones**; "How Was I Supposed To Know?" hit No.1 Billboard Digital Song Sales; 1.4M Spotify monthly listeners.

## Assessment
- `authoritative: yes` — Music Business Worldwide (MBW), recognized domain authority in the music business.
- Establishes the Hallwood Media ↔ Suno investment link, Hallwood's AI-music strategy, and its roster (Xania Monet, Imoliver). Supports Q2 (Hallwood's AI-music funding exposure) and Q3 (Hallwood CEO/founder Neil Jacobson + AI-artist focus).
